description: Korean private pension (연금저축·IRP) income tax: withholding rate by age (under 70 5%, under 80 4%, 80+ 3%, lifelong annuity 3%, lower applies; 소득세법 제129조), up to 15M KRW a year can end with withholding (separate taxation, 제14조③9호다목), above 15M choose comprehensive taxation or 15% separate taxation (제64조의4).
